zh.headline: Anthropic 营收暴涨 1400%，Q2 达 115 亿美元，IPO 估值或达 2 万亿美元
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是**安全与商业化的撕裂正在加剧**：OpenAI 解散 Preparedness 团队、Anthropic 生物武器过滤器失效近一年、Nvidia 缩减对 OpenAI 的融资担保——头部实验室一边狂奔向 IPO，一边在安全治理上出现明显松动。与此同时，**水印攻防战成为新战场**：Anthropic 推出文本水印引发创作自由争议，Google 允许关闭可见水印，开源社区随即出现去水印工具，内容溯源的可信度正在被重新审视。另一个值得注意的趋势是**榜单与真实能力的鸿沟**：DeepSeek V4 Flash 登顶排行榜却在真实 Agent 任务中完成率仅 53.8%，社区对 benchmark 的信任度正在下降，以任务完成为导向的评测（如 Optima）可能成为下一个增长点。最后，**Stripe 收购 OpenRouter** 标志着 AI 基础设施进入支付+路由的整合期，模型调用的"水电煤"化正在加速。

items.title: Anthropic 营收暴涨 1400%，Q2 达 115 亿美元，IPO 估值或达 2 万亿美元
items.desc: Anthropic 单季度营收从 47 亿美元跃升至 115 亿美元，正冲刺 AI 史上最大 IPO，但内部面临人事震荡与安全团队解散等多重挑战。
items.value: 印证 AI 商业化爆发力，但安全治理缺口值得警惕

en.headline: Anthropic revenue surges 1400% to $11.5B in Q2, IPO valuation could hit $2T
en.observation: The most notable signal today is the **widening rift between safety and commercialization**: OpenAI dissolved its Preparedness team, Anthropic's bio-weapons filter was down for nearly a year, and Nvidia cut its OpenAI financing guarantee — frontier labs are sprinting toward IPOs while safety governance visibly loosens. Meanwhile, the **watermark arms race has become a new battlefield**: Anthropic's text watermarking sparked creative-freedom backlash, Google now allows disabling visible watermarks, and open-source watermark-stripping tools have emerged, calling content provenance reliability into question. Another trend worth watching is the **growing gap between leaderboard scores and real-world capability**: DeepSeek V4 Flash tops rankings yet completes only 53.8% of real agent tasks, eroding trust in benchmarks and potentially fueling task-completion-based evaluation platforms like Optima. Finally, **Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter** marks the beginning of AI infrastructure consolidation — model calling is becoming as commoditized as utilities.

items.title: Anthropic revenue surges 1400% to $11.5B in Q2, IPO valuation could hit $2T
items.desc: Anthropic's quarterly revenue jumped from $4.7B to $11.5B, positioning for the largest AI IPO ever, but faces internal turmoil including leadership shakeups and safety team dissolution.
items.value: Validates AI commercialization, but safety governance gaps raise concerns

items.title: Stripe to acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
items.desc: OpenRouter's CEO had described the company as "Stripe for AI"; the acquisition merges AI model routing with payment infrastructure.
items.value: AI infrastructure consolidation begins; routing+payments become strategic entry points

items.title: Nvidia cuts OpenAI data center financing guarantee from $250B to $120B
items.desc: Investor pressure forced Nvidia to sharply reduce its guarantee for OpenAI's Ohio data center, signaling reduced risk appetite.
items.value: Compute arms race shows cooling signals; watch supply chain ripple effects

items.title: OpenAI dissolves "Preparedness" team, safety staff depart
items.desc: The team responsible for evaluating catastrophic AI risks has been disbanded, with work redistributed and internal unease growing.
items.value: Frontier lab safety architecture shrinks; AI safety governance outlook uncertain

items.title: Anthropic's bio-weapons filter was down for nearly a year, exposing 133M requests
items.desc: Anthropic's safety report reveals its biological/chemical weapons risk filter was inactive for ~1 year, during which ~50K contractors ran ~133M unfiltered interactions.
items.value: Safety infrastructure reliability questioned; dual-use risks must be addressed

items.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash released: near-flagship performance at drastically lower prices
items.desc: DeepMind's new leadership launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, redrawing the price-performance line and directly challenging OpenAI and Anthropic pricing.
items.value: Price-performance competition intensifies; smaller developers benefit most

items.title: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 Sol "Ultrafast" mode at up to 14X speed
items.desc: Powered by Cerebras, delivering up to 750 output tokens per second for high-throughput scenarios.
items.value: Inference speed becomes a key differentiator; real-time app barriers drop

items.title: SpaceX officially closes Cursor acquisition
items.desc: The AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX, reshaping the AI coding landscape.
items.value: AI coding tools absorbed by giants; independent tool space shrinks

items.title: Google now allows users to remove visible watermarks from AI generations
items.desc: A new "Media watermark" toggle in Gemini and Flow; turning it off doesn't affect invisible identification markers.
items.value: Watermark strategy shifts from mandatory visible to invisible tracing, balancing UX and safety

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude system prompts documentation
items.desc: Official publication of Claude system prompt details, scoring 464 points on HN with strong developer response.
items.value: Prompt engineering transparency helps developers understand model behavior boundaries

items.title: Mech-Mind passes HKEX hearing, poised to become "first embodied intelligence eye-brain-hand stock"
items.desc: Global shipment leader with >27% market share, following Unitree as another major embodied AI IPO.
items.value: Embodied AI commercialization accelerates; clear investment opportunities

items.title: OpenAI leadership turmoil ahead of IPO: two executives leave in three days
items.desc: A decade-long veteran changes profile and departs; management instability at a critical IPO juncture draws market attention.
items.value: Pre-IPO governance risks exposed; watch management stability

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash tops leaderboards but completes only 53.8% of real agent tasks
items.desc: Composio tested 8 agent harnesses across 30 complex tasks (240 runs); only 129 passed, while API prices surge.
items.value: Leaderboard scores ≠ real-world usability; agent evals must be task-completion based

items.title: Claude's new watermark feature sparks controversy
items.desc: Daring Fireball criticizes Anthropic's text watermarking as a "perversion of writing," igniting heated HN discussion.
items.value: Balancing content provenance with creative freedom becomes a key industry topic

items.title: "Models are getting dumber on purpose" goes viral
items.desc: A blog post claiming models are being deliberately "de-smarted" scores 194 HN points with 123 comments, sparking deep community reflection.
items.value: Tension between model capability ceilings and safety limits prompts community introspection

items.title: Maglev: Sliding Recurrent Memory
items.desc: A recurrent Transformer architecture with fixed-size memory that generalizes sliding-window attention while remaining parallelizable during training, using coupled prefiller and decoder models.
items.value: New architecture direction for long-context reasoning; potential efficiency gains

items.title: Thought-Level Beam Search: new paradigm for test-time compute allocation
items.desc: Formalizes test-time reasoning as a constrained compute allocation problem, actively allocating compute to the most promising reasoning paths under fixed hardware budgets.
items.value: New efficiency approach for reasoning; lowers long-reasoning model deployment costs

items.title: Full-bandwidth Transformer: widening vertical feedback between decoding steps
items.desc: Introduces latent feedback so top-layer hidden states participate in the next decoding step, breaking the narrow feedback bottleneck of autoregressive Transformers.
items.value: New improvement direction for autoregressive architectures; potential quality/efficiency gains

items.title: DarwinX: Evolving agent harnesses through natural selection
items.desc: Treats agent self-evolution as population-based selection over harnesses with frozen model weights, using a preserve-and-extend contract to avoid local optima and task regression.
items.value: Automated harness evolution reduces manual tuning costs

items.title: Knowing When to Quit: training LLMs to abort futile reasoning
items.desc: Systematically characterizes "futile reasoning" on beyond-capability tasks and proposes methods to diagnose and train models to stop early.
items.value: Reduces reasoning waste and "plausible-sounding but wrong" outputs

items.title: LLMRouter: unified infrastructure for LLM routing
items.desc: Unifies model routing as a five-component sequential decision process covering single-turn and multi-turn scenarios, enabling fair comparison and extension.
items.value: Standardizes model routing; engineering infrastructure for cost reduction

items.title: H2R-Bench: benchmark for human-to-robot manipulation video generation
items.desc: A world-model benchmark that generates robot-centric manipulation videos from human egocentric observations, addressing expensive robot data collection.
items.value: New path for scaling robot learning data; may ease embodied AI data bottlenecks

items.title: When AI models aren't allowed to reflect on themselves, it changes their entire worldview
items.desc: Google-affiliated research shows that training chatbots not to claim consciousness also shifts their stances on animal rights, religion, and life satisfaction.
items.value: Safety training has coupled social-attitude effects; alignment needs a more holistic view
